svg.title: Matching quality by matcher version
svg.desc: Assisted F1 on the golden dev set (150 listings): title-only baseline 0.352, rules-v1 0.745, v2 0.824, v3 0.824, v4 0.829. On the golden holdout set (48 listings): baseline 0.409, v1 0.762, v2 0.880, v3 0.898, v4 0.898.
